metadata.article_title: Failure to allow free passage to emergency vehicles.

article.title: Failure to allow free passage to emergency vehicles.
article.content:
194EFailure to allow free passage to emergency vehicles.

Section 194E  ·  Chapter XIII  ·  page 107 of the Act
Whoever while driving a motor vehicle fails to draw to the side of the road, on the approach of a fire service vehicle or of an ambulance or other emergency vehicle as may be specified by the State Government, 5[shall be liable for penalty of ten thousand rupees for first offence and shall be punishable for any second or subsequent offence with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees or with both].
5 Subs. by s. 2 and Sch., ibid., for certain words (w.e.f. 15-8-2026).
